cues.text: Namaste! Dekhiye, apni details ka form kaise bharna hai. Bas kuch aasaan steps hain.
Step one. WhatsApp par Eko ka message kholiye, aur neele link par tap kijiye.
Step two. Link khulne mein thoda time lag sakta hai. Das se bees second rukiye. Page band mat kijiye.
Step three. Link nahi khul raha? To message ko kisi bhi number par ek baar forward kijiye. Pehle, message ko daba kar rakhiye.
Phir upar, forward wale nishaan par tap kijiye.
Ab koi bhi number chuniye, jaise apna doosra number, ya ghar ka koi. Aur send kijiye.
Ab us chat mein, forward kiye hue message ke link par tap kijiye. Link khul jayega.
Step four. Form khul gaya! Pehle yeh peela box padhiye. Form sirf ek baar submit hota hai.
Aapki saari details pehle se bhari hain. Har detail dhyan se padhiye. Sahi hai, to kuch mat badliye.
Step five. Agar koi detail galat hai, to us box par tap kijiye. Yahan email ki spelling galat hai.
Keyboard ke backspace button se galat text mitaiye.
Ab sahi detail type kijiye.
Ho gaya. Email ab sahi hai.
Gender galat hai? To sahi wale circle par tap kijiye. Address aur branch bhi aise hi sahi kijiye.
Step six. Apni photo bhejiye. Photograph mein, Choose or take a photo button par tap kijiye.
Camera chuniye, ya gallery se apni achhi photo chuniye.
Seedha camera ki taraf dekhiye. Roshni achhi ho, peeche saadi deewar ho. Chashma ya topi nahi. Phir photo kheenchiye.
Photo bheji ja rahi hai. Thoda rukiye.
Hara message aa gaya, matlab photo pahunch gayi.
Step seven. Agar documents wale sawaal dikhein, to haan ya nahi chuniye.
Sab check ho gaya? Ab neeche submit button dabaiye.
Ho gaya! Aapki details Eko tak pahunch gayi.
Yaad rakhiye. Link khulne mein time lage, to thoda rukiye.
Na khule, to message kisi number par forward karke kholiye.
Har detail check kijiye. Galat ho, to sahi kijiye.
Apni saaf photo bhejiye.
Form sirf ek baar submit hota hai, aur link teen din tak chalta hai.
Koi dikkat ho, to apne R M se baat kijiye.
Dhanyavaad!
